identity.summary: Real MAS-licensed Singapore insurer; Singapore Life Ltd; founded 2014/2017 by Walter de Oude; merged with Aviva Singapore (announced 2020, company says 2022); Sumitomo Life bought Aviva's 25.9% stake in 2023; CEO Pearlyn Phau.
identity.how_openserp_helped: Search + Wikipedia and company page extraction worked well.
identity.what_was_missing: Merger date inconsistent across sources (2020 deal vs 2022 per company).

business_and_headcount.summary: Life/health/savings/investment insurer, also Singlife Financial Advisers, presence in Philippines. Headcount only from third-party aggregators (Revelio snippet: 1,615 employees Mar 2026 for 'Singlife Financial'; ZoomInfo 501-1,000 for the advisers arm); unreliable and not extracted.
business_and_headcount.what_was_missing: No authoritative headcount; Revelio extract failed.

financial_performance.summary: Annual report snippet: new business grew over 20% and net customer growth over 20% (2025). Third-party review claims AUM S$10B+ (unverified, appears low). Actual profit figures not read: annual report and financial statement PDFs found but extraction failed or not attempted.
financial_performance.what_was_missing: PDF extraction failed (502); no profit numbers.

layoffs_restructuring.summary: Two searches returned only generic Singapore layoff pages, no Singlife-specific item. Absence of results is weak evidence, not proof of no layoffs.
layoffs_restructuring.how_openserp_helped: Search ran but returned generic results.
layoffs_restructuring.what_was_missing: Could not check layoffsg tracker for Singlife entries.

culture_and_sentiment.summary: Glassdoor snippets: 3.4/5 from 254 reviews; ~53-54% recommend to a friend; work-life balance 3.6 (Singapore 3.7); culture 3.5; career opportunities 3.3. Review text unreadable.
culture_and_sentiment.how_openserp_helped: Search snippets carried the aggregate ratings.
culture_and_sentiment.what_was_missing: Glassdoor extract failed; no review text.

pay_and_benefits.summary: Snippets: Glassdoor average Operations salary in Singapore S$5,300 (5 salaries only); generic Operations Analyst average S$5,301/mo on Indeed. Nothing for relationship manager; benefits only 'flexi work' in review phrases.
pay_and_benefits.what_was_missing: Salary pages not extractable; tiny samples; no RM data.

interview_and_hiring.summary: Interview review pages exist (Glassdoor 35 reviews, NodeFlair) but not read. Snippet: internship difficulty 3/5.

red_flags_and_scams.summary: Singlife homepage carries a scam-call alert about people impersonating Singlife staff or financial adviser representatives (customer-facing scam, not hiring scam). No regulatory penalty found, but search was weak.
red_flags_and_scams.what_was_missing: No dedicated MAS enforcement search results.

recent_news.summary: Feb 2026 launch of gold-backed ILPs (Wikipedia citing Straits Times); Oct 2026 Straits Times piece on CEO Phau eyeing growth and acquisitions (snippet only); Oct 2026 Bloomberg: Sumitomo Life CEO targets acquisitions in SE Asia/US.
recent_news.what_was_missing: Articles not read; newsroom page extracted with no news content.

blocked_or_unreadable_sites: singlife.com newsroom (200 but no news text, likely JS-rendered)
misleading_or_wrong_results: Layoff queries returned unrelated Canva/Porsche/generic results
Scam query returned generic scam checkers
Headcount results were for 'Singlife Financial' / advisers arm, not the whole group
Third-party review gives AUM S$10B+ and Founded 2014 vs Wikipedia 2017

verdict.reasoning: Search finds the right pages and snippets carry key numbers, but extraction failed on almost every high-value page (Glassdoor, PDFs, aggregators), so culture, pay, interview and financial detail rest on snippets.
what_else_a_job_seeker_would_need: Relationship manager pay and commission structure
